item.title: 0.11.0-rr.1-beta.3
item.description:
0.11.0-rr.1-beta.3

Bridgey by Round Robin 0.11.0-rr.1 Beta 3

New

- Calls window on the Mac: dial, search your phone's contacts and see recent calls, choose the SIM, and start a phone or WhatsApp call through your phone. Call audio stays on the phone or its earbuds.

- Off until you turn it on, and each Mac needs your permission on the phone. Ask on this phone first makes every call wait for your tap.

Turn it on in Settings > Calls on both devices.

item.title: 0.11.0-rr.1-beta.1
item.description:
0.11.0-rr.1-beta.1

Bridgey by Round Robin 0.11.0-rr.1 Beta 1

New

- Quiet media during calls: when a call starts, music and videos on your allowed devices pause, or mute if they can't pause. After the last call, sound comes back and playback resumes (you can change both in Settings).

- Alerts follow the Mac you're using. Other Macs get them quietly. Attach and screen sharing list your devices so you can choose where things go.

- Phone files: right-click to Copy Optimised or Copy Original, and Download Optimised or Download Original. ⌘C copies optimised, ⌥⌘C copies the original. Choose the default in Settings > Files.

- The menu bar panel now opens with a short drop from the icon. Turn it off in Settings > General > Animate the menu bar panel.

- File selection: Shift-click for a range, ⌘-click to add or remove, ⌘A for all.

Fixes

- The send preview, the drop toast with Reduce Motion and the release signer check on newer Android build tools.

item.title: 0.10.0-rr.1-beta.27
item.description:
0.10.0-rr.1-beta.27

Share from your phone with one tap: choose Send to device and it goes to the device you are using right now. You get a moment to cancel or pick another device, and the phone tells you when it opened or why it did not. In Settings, When I share can be set to Always ask.

Links from other devices now open right away unless you turned that off. A new link replaces one still waiting instead of being refused.

Each device can stop sharing when it is in use from Settings.

Local agents on a Mac can read new message codes for a few minutes if you turn it on in Settings > Notifications. It starts off.

item.title: 0.10.0-rr.1-beta.26
item.description:
0.10.0-rr.1-beta.26

Trusted servers get only the permissions you choose on your phone, for the duration you choose. A separate Read your notifications permission lets an agent read the current notifications allowed by your existing forwarding switch and blocked-app list. It starts off and does not allow replies or dismissal.

Revoking or expiring a code or clipboard permission now stops pending delivery. One-time codes remain available to each independently granted server, and their freshness limit includes time while the phone sleeps.

This release also includes the merged menu-panel and Settings improvements, Tailscale setup guidance, and local actions for known copied links, phone numbers and email addresses.

Existing devices, pairings and permission choices are preserved. No permissions are enabled by this update.

Built on Bridgey by Semyon Mikhailov. Built with the assistance of OpenAI Codex.
